description: Demonstrates the grouped/sibling ResultSets proposal from Discussion #45 (proposed, not yet finalized): a ResultSet from one mutant of a mutation-testing sweep, carrying a group object that joins it to its sibling ResultSets (one per mutant) via a shared group_id. role names this member's kind within the group, label gives it a human-readable name, and sequence records its 0-indexed position when the producer knows the group's total size upfront (verified against AshwinUgale/muteval's real runner.py: select_mutants() materializes the full mutant list via generate_mutants() before any per-mutant evaluation begins, so sequence is not dead weight for that real-world case). group_id is the only required sub-field -- role/label/sequence are all optional. This ResultSet also uses attempt+isolation (Discussion #22) internally for its own runs_per_mutant majority vote, showing the two conventions compose without conflict.
